title: Using å Before the Infinitive
goal: Use å before infinitives, but leave it out after modal verbs.

objectives.statement: Use å before infinitives, but leave it out after modal verbs.

spans.value: Maja and Elias are deciding what to do on Saturday. Notice what appears before the second verb in each sentence.
Hva har du lyst til å gjøre på lørdag?

blocks.translation: What do you feel like doing on Saturday?

spans.value: Jeg vil besøke det nye museet.

blocks.translation: I want to visit the new museum.

spans.value: Det høres bra ut. Jeg liker å se moderne kunst.

blocks.translation: That sounds good. I like seeing modern art.

spans.value: Kan du møte meg i sentrum klokka elleve?

blocks.translation: Can you meet me in the city centre at eleven?

spans.value: Jeg må jobbe om morgenen, men jeg kan komme klokka tolv.

blocks.translation: I have to work in the morning, but I can come at twelve.

spans.value: Fint. Etter museet håper jeg å spise på den nye kafeen.

blocks.translation: Great. After the museum, I hope to eat at the new café.

spans.value: Ja! Jeg prøver alltid å finne tid til kaffe og kake.

blocks.translation: Yes! I always try to find time for coffee and cake.

spans.value: At noon, Maja sends Elias a message.
Jeg er ferdig på jobb. Jeg kan møte deg om ti minutter.

blocks.translation: I have finished work. I can meet you in ten minutes.

prompt.value: Choose one group of Norwegian statements.

options.text: Maja kan spise. Elias skal reise.
options.why: These modal verbs take bare infinitives, so this group does not show å plus an infinitive.

options.text: Maja liker spise. Elias håper komme.
options.why: The non-modal verbs liker and håper require å before the infinitives.

options.text: Maja liker å spise. Elias håper å reise.
options.why: Both non-modal first verbs are followed by å and the unchanged infinitive.

stem.value: Which group has å introducing each second verb after a non-modal first verb?

prompt.value: Complete each Norwegian sentence by choosing the form required after the first verb.

explanation.value: Modal verbs take a bare infinitive, while verbs such as «håpe» and «prøve» take «å + infinitive». The infinitive itself does not change.
